chapter: Left out of the jazz books; Tatum, Handy and family
title: Playing guitar and banjo in 'Lady Sings the Blues'
summary: He played guitar and banjo in the Billie Holiday film and was consulted with Harry Edison, but the director wanted a love story, not her real story.
